== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|LIN-V8K (Elleyein-Veeatekay)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/linv8k_japanese_white_border/50615 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/01f22343fec142f6ba11bad97f889ecc/IMG_20220607_0123.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(28, 10, 728, 1054)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d5fcc53db7a8b8820a9a2420d0e17ee6c0e4a1688a40a0e3610786d0818ef98f</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
